card.name: Partway through agent nouns ending -ers
card.fires_on: Responds to a word piece inside a longer word that is about to end in an agent-noun suffix such as -ivers, -ievers, -ators, -ucers, -ingers or -shippers. It appears mostly in plural 'doer' nouns.

modes.label: Plural person nouns
modes.description: Partway through a plural noun naming people by what they do, such as achievers, lawgivers or deceivers.

modes.label: Plural agent nouns in technical text
modes.description: Partway through a plural noun naming a thing or group that performs an action, such as inducers or laminators.

card.writes: It promotes plural agent nouns such as generators, drivers, regulators and controllers, so it pushes the model to finish the word as a plural doer noun.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a word that is about to become a plural 'one who does X' noun, like achievers or inducers.
